recentItems.title: How LA Found Its Sound With Kalan.FrFr (feat. Warren G, Kurupt, will.i.am, Yo-Yo & More)
recentItems.description:
In 'How LA Found Its Sound,' @KALANFRFR hits the streets of LA to explore the golden age of West Coast hip-hop, connecting with icons like @WarrenG, Yo-Yo, @thaofficialkurupt, and @illwilly to uncover the people and places that defined the city, as further explored in FX’s The Drop: A Snowfall Saga. Premieres 9.8 on @fxnetworks and @hulu #FXPartner
